backup-description: Export your database to a file or replace it using an existing backup.
backup-scope: Backups include specimens, tests, presets, data fields, and their referenced images. App preferences and generated PDFs are not included.
backup-restore-confirm-message: This permanently replaces all current specimens, tests, presets, data fields, and uploaded images with the contents of the selected backup.
backup-record-summary: Backup contains {{specimens}} specimens, {{tests}} tests, {{presets}} presets, {{dataFields}} data fields, and {{images}} images.
